description: This file defines an interface for a grain in Orleans, a distributed application framework. The interface includes a method to retrieve the last stream value.

classes.name: IStreamInterceptionGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain interface for stream interception, extends IGrainWithGuidKey, includes method to get last streamed value.

methods.name: GetLastStreamValue
methods.description: Asynchronous method that returns the last value received on a stream, as an integer.
